verses.text: Al t'a heb' etchonhab' icha tik: Schonhab' Dios kaji, xajan onh yuj, xa chi, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin to swak'och in b'a ch'oxnab'ilok yet' heb' wuninal yet' pax ix snun heb', yuj chi' ix walan icha tik t'a heb' unin chi': Ha ix he nun chi' manhxo wetb'eyumok ix, manhxo in yetb'eyumok pax ix, palta alek t'a ix to maxtzak yak'och sb'a ix ajmulal, yaktejokab'kan heb' winh sk'uman ix chi'.
Tato hanheja' sk'ulan ix icha chi', ol wak' k'ixwelal ix, ol wik'el spichul ix, ol kan b'eran ix icha yik ix alji. Ichawal takinh lum ol ajkan ix wu'uj, ol champax ix yuj takinhti'al.
Manh ol ok'paxlaj in k'ol t'ayex, yujto yune' ex ix t'a yajmulal.

Ha ix he nun chi', ix och ix ajmulal. Ix ixtaxel swach'ilal ix ayik ix yalan ix icha tik: Ol b'at in say mach nib'ab'il wu'uj, mach tz'ak'an in wa'el yet' tas swuk'ej, mach tz'ak'an in lana yet' in lino, in perfume yet' in wino, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ichato ol in mak sb'e ix t'a te' k'i'ix, ol wak'anoch makte' t'a spatiktak, yuj chi' manhxo ol ilchaj sb'e ix b'aj ol b'atok.

Ol b'at tzak'an ix t'a spatik mach snib'ej chi', palta manh ol yamchaj yuj ix. Ol sayek' ix, palta manhxo ol ilchaj yuj ix. Yuj chi' ol yalan ix icha tik: Ol in meltzaj t'a winh wik'nak t'a sb'ab'elal. Wach'taxon waj yet' winh t'a yichanh icha tikne'ik, xcham ix, xin chi t'a heb'.

Yuj tas sk'ulej heb' wetisraelal chi', yuj chi' ix yal Jehová icha tik: Maj yojtakejel heb' tato a in swak' strigo heb', swino heb' yet' sperfume heb' to a in swak' niwanb'ok k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro t'a heb', haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios ix yak' heb'.
Yuj chi' ol wik'ek' ixim in trigo yet' in wino, ol wik'anpaxek' nok' in lana yet' in lino tz'och spichulok heb'.
K'elanoch juntzanh chonhab' ix montanb'at yik syal sb'a heb' t'a skomon diosal, ol wak'an k'ixwok heb'. Manhxa mach ol kolanel heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Ol wak' lajwok stzalajk'olal heb' yuj k'inh yik tz'alji k'e'en uj yet' t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip yet' masanil juntzanhxo k'inh tz'ochtaxoni.

Ha heb' israel ix halani: Ha juntzanh komon Dios ix ak'an sat te' uwa yet' te' higo stojolok b'aj ix kak'em ko b'a, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' a in Jehová in ol in satel juntzanh te' uwa yet' te' higo chi'. Ha b'aj awab'il chi' ol wak'och wayumtakil, haxo nok' kaltakte'al nok' ol ab'lanb'at awb'en chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och yahelal t'a yib'anh heb', yujto niwan tiempo ix yaltej incienso heb' t'a juntzanh yechel Baal. Ix laj sb'o'an sb'a heb' icha junok ix ix syak'och yuchikin yet' stonh tz'och tzak'an yuj heb' winh nib'ab'il yuj, syak'an sat sk'o'ol t'a winh yetb'eyum. Icha chi' in yutej chonhab' Israel tik.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix sk'ulej chonhab' Israel tik, palta ol in montej, ol wik'anxib'at t'a tzinan lu'um. Hata' ol wal wach' lolonel t'ay.

Ol wak'anxi slu'um b'aj awab'il yuwa. Ha sch'olanil ilk'olal ol wak'och sch'olanil yipk'olal. Icha yaj t'a sb'ab'elal ayik yelnakkot t'a Egipto icha chi' ol wutokxikani. Hata' ol tak'wok t'ayin, ichawal sk'ulej junok ix kob'es ix.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol in yal yetb'eyumok. Manhxo ol yal jun chonhab' tik to Baal waj t'ay.
Junelnhej ol wik'el t'a sti' yak'an b'inaj juntzanh Baal, manhxa b'ak'inh ol yak' b'inajok.

Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol wak' in trato yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok', nok' much yet' nok' chan, yik manhxalaj tas ol utaj yuj nok'. T'a junelnhej ol wik'kanel k'e'en lanza t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' yik owal, yik wach' ol yik' yip in chonhab' tik, manhxa tas ol sna'a.
Ach chonhab' Israel, ichato ol ach wik' t'a junelnhej. Toton wal icha wetb'eyum ol ach aj t'a stojolal yet' t'a smojalil, yujto ol ok' wal och in k'ol t'ayach yet' ach in xajanani.
Ichato ol ach wik'a', ol in k'ulejnhej tas ix wala', ichato chi' ol in ojtakaneli to Jehová in.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol in tak'wok t'ayach, ol wal t'a satcha'anh, haxo satcha'anh chi' ol ak'ankot nhab' t'a sat lu'um.
Ol yak'an ixim trigo lum lum, wino yet' aceite. Ichawal chi' ol aj in pakan slesal in chonhab' b'ob'il wu'uj.

Ol wak'xi kajnaj in chonhab' t'a sat lum lum tik yik tz'och wet'ok. Ol ok' in k'o'ol t'a ix “Manh-xajanab'ilok” yet' t'a winhaj “Manh-in-chonhab'ok”, ol walan icha tik: In chonhab' ach, xin chama. Haxo ol halan t'ayin: In Diosal ach, xchama, xchi Jehová.
